contract: Compare Matroska stream discovery with avformat_find_stream_info on the formats build. Fold stream ordinal, codec, width, height and complete codec configuration. PGS canvas comes from buffered packets and the VobSub canvas from CodecPrivate.

Replay the discovery prefix and then continue playback in source order. Compare every stream ordinal, optional source PTS and DTS in nanoseconds, key flag, length and packet bytes. The reference reads a fresh raw demux pass. Matroska Blocks carry PTS only, including DVB packets for which the reference additionally reports a demux DTS equal to PTS.

Compact discovery checks that each buffered AVC or AAC feed selects the original event by ordinal, that a non-packet event or unselected track produces no packet, and that an invalid ordinal is refused. Consume the prefix and check the original event order, source, packet clocks, configuration and payload. Fold the original packet bytes and reconstruct legacy ASC from the first ADTS header emitted by the actual feed. The reference folds its discovered extradata and source packets.

Full discovery includes the HEVC/Dolby feed duration projection for Dolby packets. The indexed seek case folds the selected HEVC packets admitted from the landing keyframe and the gate's landed verdict.
Trace the candidate cutoff and buffered output count. The packet sequence is compared through the end independent of the readiness cutoff.

open_deviations.reading: Seven declared channels do not identify a legacy AAC-LC layout
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 section 3.4.6 has no initialization for A_AAC/MPEG4/LC. RFC 9559 section 5.1.4.1.29.3 defines a channel count. ISO/IEC 14496-3 AudioSpecificConfig channel configuration 7 designates eight channels, as documented by the framing crate.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses to derive an AAC-LC initialization from the seven-channel count.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes ASC 11b8 with channel configuration 7, then replays eight packets.

open_deviations.reading: An explicitly supplied empty CodecPrivate cannot initialize AAC-LC
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 sections 3.4.1 and 3.4.6 distinguish ASC initialization from the legacy mapping with none. MatroskaFeedSetup derives ADTS parameters only for absent initialization.
open_deviations.candidate: Preserves the supplied empty record and the ASC parser reports Truncated.
open_deviations.reference: Treats the empty record as absence and derives the stereo 48000 Hz ASC 1190, then replays eight packets.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::legacy_aac_lc_empty_private for callers recovering legacy files with an empty codec record.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska replay preserves the signed PGS Block timestamp
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 11.2 makes the signed Block time a presentation timestamp.
open_deviations.candidate: Replays the initial PGS bytes with a PTS of -1000000 ns, including when the file also contains DVB.
open_deviations.reference: Leaves the negative PGS time absent on the same packets. PGS dimensions and payloads agree.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::omit_negative_pts for consumers reproducing the demux timestamp admission.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska Dolby feed refuses a damaged AC-3 first syncframe
open_deviations.clause: Matroska codec mappings draft 21 section 3.4.11 requires AC-3 syncframes. ATSC A/52:2018 sections 5.3 and 5.4.1.1 require syncword 0x0b77.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes the two discovered track descriptors and refuses the first AC-3 packet before replaying it because it starts with 0x0077.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes the two descriptors, replays the invalid 768-byte block and assigns it a duration of 32000000 ns.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::opaque_dolby_replay for consumers retrieving damaged blocks as container bytes.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska discovery keeps CodecDelay and the Dolby syncframe duration
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 sections 5.1.4.1.25 and 11.2 require exact nanosecond CodecDelay subtraction. ATSC A/52:2018 Annex E sections 2.3.1.4–2.3.1.5 give the E-AC-3 rate and coded audio block count.
open_deviations.candidate: Subtracts exact delay, including -21333333 and -23219955 ns for AAC. Where Dolby duration is requested, returns 32000000 ns from the E-AC-3 syncframe.
open_deviations.reference: Reports times on a millisecond grid, including -21000000 and -23000000 ns for AAC, and omits the E-AC-3 duration on the raw demux pass.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::demux_packet_clocks for consumers using the reference stream clock and duration inference.
